name: Exorcise
description: You touch a creature. If the target is a willing ally, you remove any dark spells, curses, or possession affecting them if your spell check beats the RC of the original effect. Additionally, the target rolls with a bonus die on all checks against dark magic for the next minute, or until they succeed on one such check. If the target is a standard or lower tier undead or dark creature, it is destroyed.
charge: Undead or dark creatures of champion tier or lower are destroyed.
